products.insurer_name: HDI Global Specialty SE – Australia, ABN 58 129 395 544, AFSL 458776
products.issuer_or_agent_name: Coffre-Fort Pty Ltd (underwriting agent); 1Cover Pty Limited (Authorised Representative)
products.pds_title: 1Cover Travel Insurance Combined Financial Services Guide and Product Disclosure Statement
products.geographic_scope: Worldwide to nominated destinations. Domestic journeys within Australia covered when destination is >200 km from home or if at least one night of pre-paid accommodation is included.
products.eligibility_rules: Australian citizens/permanent residents must reside in Australia, journeys must start and end in Australia, and a valid Medicare card is required. Temporary residents must reside in Australia, hold a current valid visa for at least 12 months, and be covered by Medicare or private health insurance extending beyond policy dates. Must purchase before leaving the departure point and list all destinations (including USA stopovers and all cruise ports if cruising).
products.age_eligibility_notes: Travellers aged 80+ are limited to a maximum 90 days per journey. Dependants must be under 19 and not in full-time employment.

waiting_period_rules.benefit: Section 12 Pre-Departure Cancellation Fees & Lost Deposits
waiting_period_rules.trigger: From issue date/time on the certificate of insurance
From issue date/time on the certificate of insurance

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Cooling-off 14 days if no travel has commenced and no claim intended. After 14 days, refund of unused premium less up to $25 administration fee if journey has not commenced and no claim. No pro-rata refund if journey ends early. For Frequent Traveller plans, no refund outside the 14-day cooling-off period.
products.excess_options: An excess per claim applies to any one event unless otherwise specified. You can select the excess amount on certain claims at purchase. A double excess applies to Sections 2, 14 and 15 if a claim arises directly from winter sports activities when the Winter Sports Pack is purchased.

excess_rules.rule: Per-claim excess applies unless stated otherwise
Double excess for Sections 2, 14, 15 if claim arises from winter sports with Winter Sports Pack

products.travel_delay_limit: $2,000 (up to $200 after 6 hours, then $200 per additional 24 hours)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: First item sub-limits per category: Computers/cameras $3,000; Mobile phones/tablets $1,000; Jewellery $750; All other items $750. Subsequent items per category: $750; $750; $250; $750.
products.luggage_delay_limit: $1,000 (up to $500 after 12 hours; up to $1,000 after 7 days)
products.rental_vehicle_excess_limit: Optional add-on: $5,000 or $10,000 (Rental Vehicle Insurance Excess Pack)
products.covid_cancellation_or_disruption_limit: Section 15(e) Additional Expenses if COVID-19 positive and unfit to travel: $5,000 per adult (not hospitalised) or $10,000 per adult (hospitalised)
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID-19 medical covered under Emergency Medical (testing/vaccinations not covered unless part of hospitalisation). Cancellation/amendment/disruption only when positively diagnosed and medically certified; no cover for close-contact-only, government bans, curfews, or border closures. Additional Expenses sub-limits per adult apply.

cruise_benefits.notes: Medical treatment onboard a cruise; for domestic waters, evacuation limited ship-to-shore

optional_add_ons.availability: Available; must be purchased ≥24 hours before participating; age ≤69
Available; bicycles <3 years old, ≥$1,500; up to $5,000 per bike/$15,000 total; accessories $750
Chosen cancellation amount per policy at purchase
Available; mandatory for cruises of 2+ nights
Available only on Comprehensive; specify items (excludes drones/jewellery/watches/watercraft) up to $5,000 total
Available; choose $5,000 or $10,000; must be added before collecting vehicle
Available; must be purchased ≥24 hours before activities; age ≤69

coverage_benefits.benefit: On Trip Cancellation Fees & Lost Deposits

sub_limits.amount: Computers/cameras $3,000; Phones/tablets $1,000; Jewellery $750; All other items $750
sub_limits.basis: Per policy - first item in each category (#)
Per policy - subsequent items in same category (#)

sub_limits.sub_limit: If COVID-19 positive and unfit to travel
sub_limits.amount: $5,000 per adult (not hospitalised) or $10,000 per adult (hospitalised)
$50 per 24h boarding (delay) up to policy limits; vet up to $400

products.limit_basis_notes: All limits are per person unless specified. ^ = per adult traveller (dependants share adult’s benefits). # = per policy regardless of number of insured persons. For Frequent Traveller plans, limits reinstate each journey except Section 18 Personal Liability.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Pre-existing medical conditions are not covered unless ALL such conditions are declared at purchase, assessed and accepted in writing (endorsement) and any additional premium is paid. Includes conditions with symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, tests, follow-ups in prior 12 months, and a list of lifetime conditions (e.g., heart disease, respiratory/brain/circulatory, kidney disease, cancer, chronic or ongoing conditions).
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Unexpected, new pregnancy complications covered up to 24 weeks 6 days (single) or 19 weeks 6 days (multiple). Must return home by 25th week (single) or 20th week (multiple). No cover for regular antenatal care, fertility treatment, childbirth, newborn care, or undisclosed prior/current complications. Disclose assisted conception (e.g., IVF).
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cancellation/curtailment for relatives in AU/NZ: cover if aged ≤84. If due to a relative’s pre-existing condition and you were unaware of likelihood before issue, sub-limit $2,000 per adult applies (Sections 12/14). Family Emergency (15A) similar thresholds.

included_activities.conditions: To <30m with licence or with licensed instructor
Helmet required; valid licence per engine size/country laws
Up to 3,500m; no specialist climbing equipment

optional_activity_cover.conditions: Required for listed higher-risk activities (e.g., canyoning grade IV/V, outdoor rock climbing with ropes, tandem skydive, hang/paragliding with instructor, downhill mountain biking, etc.). No cover for Section 6 or 18 arising from these activities.
Required for winter sports; age ≤69; double excess applies to Sections 2,14,15 for winter sports claims; includes WSP1–WSP5 benefits

excluded_activities.exclusion: Hunting, mountaineering, quad biking/ATV, dirt bikes; non-licensed air-supported devices

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Eligible rental vehicles only (cars, campervans, motorhomes, people movers ≤4.5t). Cover is for the rental company’s excess/damage liability fee only; not a substitute for rental insurance. Excludes tyres/windscreens/roof/underbody if not covered by rental provider. Must add the pack before collecting vehicle. Claims require rental agreement, incident report, repair account and written demand. No cover if driving illegally, unlicensed, intoxicated, or in breach of the rental agreement, or for admin/loss-of-use fees.
products.luggage_conditions: Depreciation applies. In motor vehicles during daylight, theft cover limited to $200 per item and $2,000 total if forced entry and item in concealed, locked compartment. No cover for valuables in checked baggage unless required by carrier with written confirmation. Unattended property exclusions apply. Proof of police/carrier report required for theft/delay claims.

general_exclusions.heading: Known circumstances/Change of plans
general_exclusions.summary: Losses arising from circumstances known before purchase, intended/planned procedures, or change of mind.

general_exclusions.heading: Financial collapse
general_exclusions.summary: No cover for insolvency/financial collapse of travel/accommodation providers or agents.

general_exclusions.heading: Motorcycle/moped/scooter use
general_exclusions.summary: No cover if unlicensed/riding without helmet/engine size vs licence mismatch.

general_exclusions.heading: Epidemic/Pandemic
general_exclusions.summary: General exclusion except specified COVID-19 covers; no cover for quarantine/government bans/curfews.

general_exclusions.heading: Travel warnings and sanctions
general_exclusions.summary: No cover for ‘Do Not Travel’ or advised-against areas/activities absent exemption; sanctions restrictions apply.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover where Smartraveller advice is ‘Do Not Travel’/advises against specific arrangements unless exempted; sanctions/health legislation may bar cover or payments.
products.claims_process_summary: Notify claims as soon as practicable and within 180 days of return date. Emergency/medical claims: contact assistance promptly and seek prior approval for hospitalisation or outpatient costs >$1,000. Provide police/carrier reports for theft/delay, original receipts/proof of ownership, medical reports, and identification. Assessment within ~10 business days once complete information received. Paid in AUD by EFT.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 assistance. Must contact assistance for medical transfer/evacuation and for hospitalisation or outpatient treatment expected to exceed $1,000. Failure may reduce payable expenses. Emergency numbers provided incl. AU 1300 884 508, International +61 2 8776 3010 (see p125).
products.premium_factors: Destination(s), journey duration, selected plan, selected excess, number and ages of travellers, selected cancellation amount, and any add-ons. Government charges/taxes may apply.

source_evidence.quote: Combined Financial Services Guide And Product Disclosure Statement Effective 4 March 2026 — 1Cover Travel Insurance

Plans Available... Comprehensive (Travellers of all ages); Overseas Frequent Traveller (Travellers aged 69 or under); Medical Only (Travellers aged 69 or under); Domestic (Travellers of all ages); Domestic Frequent Traveller (Travellers aged 69 or under); Already Overseas (Travellers aged 69 or under).

This plan covers an unlimited number of journeys... for a 12-month period... You can choose from 21 days and 45 days per trip. Journeys solely within Australia covered only when destination is more than 200 kilometres from your home, or include at least one night of pre-paid accommodation. All benefit limits reinstated at end of each journey (except Personal Liability).

Already Overseas... purchase within 5 days of departure or expiry of other policy; must intend to return to Australia with evidence of return flight; journeys up to maximum of 90 days. Under this plan cover under all sections starts 72 hours after issue date/time.

Benefits Table (Sections 1–21) with limits by plan; Luggage $15,000 (Comprehensive/Already Overseas), $7,500 (Domestic); Cancellation ‘Chosen Limit’; Additional Accommodation & Travel Expenses $50,000 (Comprehensive/Already Overseas) and $5,000 (Domestic); Personal Liability $5,000,000; etc.

If positively diagnosed with COVID-19 and unfit to travel: Comprehensive/Overseas Frequent $5,000 per adult (not hospitalised) or $10,000 per adult (hospitalised); Domestic/Domestic FT $2,000 per adult; Already Overseas $5,000/$10,000.
You must purchase the Cruise Pack to be covered on board a cruise... CP1–CP7 benefits and limits (Unlimited; $1,000; $2,500; $1,500; $750; $1,500; $500).
Cooling-off 14 days... After 14 days refund less up to $25 admin fee if journey hasn’t commenced and no claim. No refund outside 14 days for Frequent Traveller plans.
Submit claim as soon as practicable and within 180 days of the return date; assessment within 10 business days once all info received.
General Exclusions including epidemics/pandemics, financial collapse, motor vehicles and licensing, travel warnings (‘Do Not Travel’), sanctions; cruising and winter sports require relevant pack.

waiting_period_rules.trigger: From issue date/time on certificate (events within/before waiting period not covered)

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Cooling-off 14 days if no claim and cover has not commenced within 72-hour waiting period.
products.excess_options: An excess per claim applies unless otherwise specified. Selected excess amount may be available at purchase. Double excess applies to Sections 2, 14 and 15 if claim arises directly from winter sports activities when Winter Sports Pack is purchased.

excess_rules.rule: Per-claim excess applies unless otherwise specified
Double excess for Sections 2, 14, 15 for winter sports claims with Winter Sports Pack

products.luggage_single_item_limit: First item per category: Computers/cameras $3,000; Phones/tablets $1,000; Jewellery $750; All other $750. Subsequent items: $750/$750/$250/$750.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_limit: Optional add-on: $5,000 or $10,000 (Rental Vehicle Insurance Excess Pack)
products.covid_cancellation_or_disruption_limit: Section 15(e): $5,000 per adult (not hospitalised) or $10,000 per adult (hospitalised) if COVID-19 positive and unfit to travel
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID-19 medical covered; testing/vaccinations excluded unless part of hospitalisation. On-trip cancellation/disruption available when positively diagnosed and medically certified; no cover for government restrictions or close-contact-only.

optional_add_ons.availability: Chosen limit at purchase (applies to Section 14 only for this plan)

coverage_benefits.benefit: On Trip Cancellation Fees & Lost Deposits

sub_limits.amount: Computers/cameras $3,000 first/$750 subsequent; Phones/tablets $1,000/$750; Jewellery $750/$250; All other $750/$750
sub_limits.basis: # per policy for category caps; per item limits apply

sub_limits.sub_limit: If COVID-19 positive and unfit to travel

products.limit_basis_notes: All limits per person unless ^ per adult (dependants share) or # per policy. 72-hour waiting period applies to all sections from issue date/time.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Pre-existing medical conditions only covered if declared, assessed and accepted in writing with any additional premium paid.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Serious new complications covered up to 24w+6d (single) or 19w+6d (multiple). No routine antenatal care, childbirth, newborn care or undisclosed complications.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Relative-based cancellation/curtailment sub-limits in Sections 14 and 15 as per plan conditions.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Excess/damage liability only; pack must be purchased before vehicle collection; excludes admin/loss-of-use; licence/law compliance required; documentation required.
products.luggage_conditions: Daytime theft from vehicles limited; unattended property exclusions; valuables in checked baggage excluded unless required by carrier with written confirmation; police/carrier report required.

general_exclusions.heading: Epidemic/Pandemic and government restrictions
general_exclusions.summary: Specified COVID-19 covers only; no cover for border closures/quarantine.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover in ‘Do Not Travel’ locations or where advisories warn against relevant travel unless exempted; sanctions may apply.
products.claims_process_summary: Claims within 180 days of return; 72-hour waiting period from issue applies; contact assistance for hospitalisation or >$1,000 outpatient costs; provide required documentation.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 assistance; prior approval for evacuation/hospitalisation or >$1,000 outpatient costs. AU 1300 884 508; Intl +61 2 8776 3010.
products.premium_factors: Destination(s), duration, ages, number of travellers, chosen cancellation amount, selected excess, add-ons.

source_evidence.quote: Aged 69 or under; returning to resume residence in Australia; evidence of return flight; purchase within 5 days; journeys up to max 90 days; cover starts 72 hours after issue.
Already Overseas includes: Sections 1–11, 14–18, 20–21; limits match Comprehensive for included sections; Rental Vehicle Excess via add-on.
Already Overseas: $5,000 per adult (not hospitalised) or $10,000 per adult (hospitalised).

products._notes: Special plan for travellers already overseas with a 72-hour waiting period from issue for all sections; one journey permitted every 12 months.
